thread.title: Starbucks, Hormel and Apple are the Yahoo Finance charts of the day

author: Yahoo Finance
title: Starbucks, Hormel and Apple are the Yahoo Finance charts of the day
text:
Let’s check out the Yahoo Finance charts of the day.
Starbucks ( SBUX ): Shares are down in early trade, at around .32%. Starbucks will close 8,000 stores at 2 p.m. Tuesday for racial bias training.
Hormel ( HRL ): Shares up here, around .73%. After consumers complained about metal objects in their food, the U.S. department of agriculture is recalling more than 228,000 pounds of Spam and another products made by Minnesota-based Hormel.
Apple ( AAPL ): Shares down here, at around .18%. According to a report from South Korea’s Electronic Times, Apple may be planning to use high-end technology in the screens of all of its new 2019 iPhone models.
For more on today’s big stock movers check out the Final Round, live at 3:55 p.m. ET, right here on Yahoo Finance.
